title: Research note (no κ; bit headroom): helper-deletion ladder under optimal window-respecting re-hosting — ≈ +0.082% c per deletion (d=0..6, certified)
body:
**Research note (bit headroom only); no κ claim.** This answers an open question from [#2423](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2423): what is each further width-8 helper deletion worth on the bit supplier, once the freed slack is re-hosted optimally while respecting stage windows? [#1043](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1043)'s R438 is d = 1. #1250 shows that helper 470 is the only removable helper on the fixed word, so d ≥ 2 prices *changed* words.

| d | R | slack S | certified optimum (unique) | c TEMPLATE (#1043's measured delta) | vs #589 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 439 | 45 | 9×(42,5) | 0.001733427039589844234749 | 0 |
| 1 | 438 | 54 | 10×(42,5)+1×(42,4) | 0.001734802047828389852783 | +0.079% |
| 2 | 437 | 63 | 12×(42,5)+1×(28,3) | 0.001736238589146810207048 | +0.162% |
| 3 | 436 | 72 | 14×(42,5)+1×(28,2) | 0.001737652736279473456500 | +0.244% |
| 4 | 435 | 81 | 16×(42,5)+1×(14,1) | 0.001739118212671177105905 | +0.328% |
| 5 | 434 | 90 | 18×(42,5) | 0.001740604775296424266918 | +0.414% |
| 6 | 433 | 99 | 19×(42,5)+1×(42,4) | 0.001741991196114600260000 | +0.494% |

**Shape of the result.**
- About **+0.082% c per deletion**, nearly linear. The steps alternate with S mod 5, which sets the partial slot.
- The optimum is always fully idle 42-slots first, with one partial slot.
- Two more illustrative per-deletion models are reported, RANK1 {1:−8} and RANK7 {7:−1, 1:−1}. Neither is an envelope, as the README explains.

**How it was checked** (`deletion_ladder.py`, reusing the pinned verify_rehost machinery of #2423):
- **Layouts:** an exact top-3 DP, cross-checked by exhaustive enumeration for every row (up to 728,466,365 layouts at d = 6).
- **Windows:** all window splits are feasible by max-flow and by Hall, and the placements are audited.
- **Endpoints:** 21 certified endpoints, each accepted at c and rejected at c + 1e-24.
- **Controls:** the run reproduces the endpoints of #589 (d = 0), #1043's certified profile and #2423's re-hosting (d = 1), and #2423's transported word (d = 1, RANK7). It has 88 negative controls.
- **Independent check:** an adversarial AI verifier recomputed all 21 rows with its own code (exhaustive layouts, Decimal endpoint bisection, a 512-subset Hall test) and matched every digit. Its three presentation fixes are applied.
- **Packaging:** `--check-only`, the 3.10 grammar check and the research tests pass. Run on CPython 3.14.4; the registered 3.12 replay was not run.

```sh
python3 -I -B research/bit-deletion-ladder/deletion_ladder.py --check research/bit-deletion-ladder/RECEIPT.json   # ~80 s
# PASS_BIT_DELETION_LADDER d=0..6 exhaustive=21/21 windows_feasible=7/7 c_template(d=6)=0.001741991196114600260000 ... no_new_kappa
```

**Scope.**
- No word exists for d ≥ 2, so the local models are declared rather than derived.
- W, the #589 frames and the windows are held fixed.
- The slot model is width-8 only, with no banks.
- The native lane was not run.
- The bit supplier does not bind κ.
- Base: main `0fdd7d82`. Card `selected-packing`, scope changed; the assignment is the bit-supplier track, seed 14.
